name: React API Layer
description: Public package entry plus the React bindings (WebSocketProvider context and the useSubscription/useSend/useConnectionState/useDynamicConnection hooks) that expose named WebSocket connections to components.

name: Core Client Layer
description: Framework-agnostic WebSocketClient handling connection lifecycle, heartbeats, typed pub/sub dispatch and offline queuing, together with the exponential and fixed backoff reconnect strategies it uses.

name: Types Layer
description: Shared type definitions (ConnectionState, BaseMessage, handler callbacks, BackoffStrategy, WebSocketClientOptions) imported by every other source module.

name: Build & Tooling Configuration
description: npm manifest, publish settings, TypeScript project configs, ESLint rules, and the Vite library-mode build plus Vitest setup that produce the dual ESM/CJS distribution.

name: Documentation
description: README usage guide and API reference for the provider, hooks and client, plus the MIT license.
